data: Exact 35 frozen complex_geometry_suite tasks; native generators validate every manifest fingerprint.
forward_only: CF1-CF5 exact consistency search, smallest key first, class-zero completion; one complete search per query, at most K*N candidate observations. Explicit no_consistent_key outcome and no fallback model when any observed query fails. Empty queries return class zero, as in the source learner. No FW updates or backpropagation.
initialization: Uniform feasible tensor; exact first Frank-Wolfe vertex by integer label counts, with smallest-index ties.
feature_banks: Relative lag tokens, padded to maximum declared split/rollout context
Latest completed distance-one successor for each token
Latest completed distance-two successor for each token
training: Full-batch Frank-Wolfe on the unfactorized nonnegative joint tensor; eta=2/(iteration+1); ordinary full-vocabulary cross-entropy at unit logit scale.
budget: floor(original max_updates / ceil(train_examples / original batch)) complete training passes, at least one. No exceeding original example exposure; partial last epoch unused.
observation: Exhaustive primary split after each complete full-batch pass; this is coarser than original intra-epoch observations on some tasks.
stopping: First primary >=99% exact sequences; otherwise all query blocks certified realizable or numerical mean per-query FW gaps <=1e-12; otherwise fixed pass budget.
seed_effect: Only fixed training summation order, shuffled once by source Random(seed+10000). No random initialization, data split or model selection.
unknown_values: Class zero on unobserved categorical rows of trained query channels; uniform logits on entirely unobserved queries. No copied-value tie-breaking.
metrics: Exact complete sequences, own-output greedy rollout through EOS/limit, source field alias pooling, all source splits at endpoint; CPU f64 instead of GPU f32.
interpretation: Benchmark transfer with a documented causal adapter and convex optimizer; not a matched transformer training-time comparison or a rerun of the selected main-model cohort. No tuning on validation outcomes.
